description: What the smoke check reads in the webapp's log, from the process start. Patterns are extended regular expressions that both grep -E and JavaScript accept. Each entry says what it guards.

required.guards: The people index of the search loaded (search-people/people.server.ts).
The title snapshot loaded from Redis (title-snapshot/index.server.ts). Discover, taste, and the explorer need it.

required.pattern: Search index build [^ ]+ loaded in [0-9]+ ms

lastLine.guards: 631ae6c4: the query encoder's worker file wasn't found in the split server bundle, and search answered with basic results only. The per-minute Process: line then says 'query encoder not ready'. The first line is written one minute after the start.

forbidden.guards: 631ae6c4: 'Query encoder failed to start'. Also the share card renderer's 'Renderer failed to start'.
631ae6c4: a file that the server bundle no longer contains at the expected path.
'Search index failed to load' and 'People index failed to load'.
1e459198: 'Cannot read properties of null (reading replace)' on titles without a poster. Earlier: toLowerCase() on a missing department.
A name that the build dropped or renamed.
Remix's text for a 500 from a loader or a render.

forbidden.pattern: Title snapshot not loaded|Title snapshot check failed|Title snapshot not updated
forbidden.guards: A snapshot that Redis didn't deliver or that was refused.
The age and content filter has no data.

forbidden.pattern: Metrics listener disabled|Metrics route manifest could not be loaded
forbidden.guards: The metrics endpoint is off or reports no route patterns.
A country's streaming availability index didn't load, so the streaming filters have no data.
The webapp runs without its cache.
An error that no handler caught.
